The board consists of 4 connected $3 \times 3$ blocks (with a removed center square), forming a cross or plus shape.
Let $N$ be the number of ways to tile one $3 \times 3$ block with a removed center (8 white squares). By enumeration, $N = 4$.
To tile the entire board, the 20 dominos must tile the 4 blocks. The tiles cannot cross the "bottlenecks" (the single-square wide necks connecting the blocks) because the outer cells of these necks are black holes in the adjacent blocks. Any domino crossing the neck would require the outer cell to be white, which it is not.

Thus, the blocks are tiled independently.
Total ways = $N \times N \times N \times N = 4^4 = 256$.

Answer: 256
